step4_real_wave.admission_and_provenSet: admission = the default tick's schedulerStep gate chain per mission; missions already proven in the mission-ledger are skipped (IDLE, dedup) and never re-spawned - hence the state reset before each repeat. In the MAIN repo ledger all 6 qualified missions are already proven (read-only check: M0001 x10, G10 x2, M0000 x14, M0002 x7, RUNTIME_SELF_AUDIT x27, QUAL_CLEAN_GATEB x76) => a wave there admits NONE (IDLE). The wave proves capacity, not new production throughput.
step4_real_wave.M0000_note: M0000 is declared and enforcement-clean but excluded from the timed wave: on a PRISTINE state its Mission Ledger stage records nothing (controlled mission, mechanical acceptance UNKNOWN), and the stage-effect check then requires runtime/generated/mission-ledger.json to exist. Reproduced on the DEFAULT (non-wave) path too: fresh state + ODG_CANARY_ALLOWLIST=M0000 => '[odg-schedule-tick] FAIL - status SUCCESS'. In a 6-wave on pristine state it failed 2 of 8 runs (when it reached that stage before any sibling had created the ledger). Pre-existing ordering dependence, not caused by waves; not fixed here (outside the write-set). M0000 is also never deduped on pristine state (never proven).
